**Dear {[C-FIRST NAME]},**
Madrid is getting closer! Here is what you need to know about the **tentative tournament schedule** and how to request spectator wristbands for family members.

d.label: PLAN YOUR MADRID EXPERIENCE
d.text: The program includes pre-tournament activities and competition days. Use the tentative schedule below to start planning your trip and time in Madrid.

d.label: IMPORTANT
d.text: This schedule is **tentative** and may change. Please follow the final information shared closer to the event.

d.c1_text: One wristband covers all tournament days. No single-day option.

d.text: Wristbands are for relatives who are not included in the Challenge package but wish to attend the tournament in Madrid. They grant ++access to the facilities only++. Transportation and other services are not included.
